name: HUSD YEP Youth Professionals Program (paid internship)
org: Hayward Unified School District (YEP Expanded Learning)
what_you_do: Paid interns work at one of 27 HUSD school sites in after-school programs. You help with tutoring, clubs, sports and events, and go to monthly job-skills meetings.
who_can_apply: Hayward Unified students in grades 10, 11 or 12. You need a work permit, a 2.0 GPA or higher, a school reference letter, and a California ID and Social Security card (or valid work authorization).
pay_detail: Paid internship. The intern pay rate is not stated on the page.
duration: School year, after school. Hours are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 flyer said apply by Friday, Aug 28, 2026 at 5 PM. The page says sign-ups usually open the last week of August and close around mid-September. Expect the next round around late August 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online registration form on the HUSD page. Qualified students are invited to a group interview, then may be placed at a school site.
notes: Only for HUSD students. The 2026-27 window has passed, so ask the YEP office if late spots open. Contact: Larry Ewings, YEP Operations Supervisor, (510) 723-3857 ext. 34157. Students who turn 18 and graduate can apply to be a YEP Program Leader (starting at $28.98 per hour).
